confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and Old Town guesthouse rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine are bounded by the local beer relationship, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX observation is from the RBA latest-rates table for 16 October 2026, which search results suggested may be provisional; the RBA overview page showed 0.6955 for 15 October 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is other mid-sized Chinese tourist cities with similar price levels, such as Dali and Guilin, with a premium applied to Lijiang Old Town accommodation for its high-altitude tourism demand.
